blocks.content: India launched a nationwide Campus Biodiversity Register initiative for higher educational institutions on 21-22 July 2026. The exercise is being implemented by the Nature Conservation Foundation, a Mysuru-based wildlife research and conservation organisation, and the National Biodiversity Authority under India’s biodiversity documentation framework.

items: The National Biodiversity Authority is a statutory body under the Biological Diversity Act, 2002.
The Nature Conservation Foundation is based in Mysuru, Karnataka.
Azim Premji University in Bengaluru published its Campus Biodiversity Register for 2024-25.
College and university campuses can function as urban green spaces and local biodiversity sites.
